name: AIFileUpload
description: The AI-themed variant of the standard DS File Upload. The single DSFileUpload component (ds/ds-file-upload.tsx) accepts theme="standard" (DS primary teal, square browse button, teal progress bar) or theme="ai". In the AI theme the only color that changes is the teal primary → AI brand blue (var(--color-ai-brand)): the drag-over border + tint and the CTA re-anchor to brand, while foreground, helper, the neutral progress track, and the success/error semantics are unchanged. The browse trigger renders the real AIButton atom (variant="primary-solid", rounded AI corners) and each uploading row renders the real AIProgress atom — both consumed, never re-implemented. Drop zone, file list, remove actions, validation states, and the inline-SVG icon set are shared with the standard control. All colors, radii, and spacing read design-system CSS variables; all text uses the "Open Sans" face.
intent: DS File Upload, AI surface theme — brand-blue accent, real AIButton CTA + AIProgress bars, shared icons.

keyboard: Ensure keyboard focus order matches visual order

usage: File upload on AI surfaces that should read as part of the AI experience
Any upload flow where the AI brand accent is preferred over the DS teal
Upload with progress feedback via the real AIProgress atom
doNotUse: Don't use on a standard (non-AI) surface — use the standard <DSFileUpload> (default theme) instead
Don't fork ds-file-upload.tsx to restyle — switch the theme prop
Don't hard-code the browse button or progress bar — the AI theme renders the real AIButton + AIProgress atoms
Do not invent dependency atoms — use bundled canonical sources
Do not hardcode brand hex — use AI tokens
